class.name: NNNodeQuerySystem
class.brief_description: A singleton that allows time budgeting for the NQS queries.
class.description: The [NNNodeQuerySystem] singleton schedules and time-budgets NQS queries across frames. It is the recommended way of executing queries; search spaces can also be executed directly with [method NNNQSSearchSpaces.execute_query] if needed. To execute a query through the singleton, post a search space with [method post_query] as either high priority or regular priority. High-priority queries are processed first using the fraction of [member run_queries_time_budget_per_frame_usec] configured by [member time_allocation_pct_to_high_priority_queries], and any remaining time in the frame budget is used for regular-priority queries. Because [NNNodeQuerySystem] inherits [Object] and does not hook into the scene tree automatically, your game must call [code]NNNodeQuerySystem.run_queries()[/code] once per frame (for example, from [method Node._physics_process] or [method Node._process]) to advance posted queries. A posted search space that exits the scene tree or is freed stops its own query. This class is an engine singleton: call its methods through [code]NNNodeQuerySystem[/code] directly; it cannot be instantiated, and variables should not be typed as it.

method.name: clear_queries
method.description: Stops and unregisters every posted query in both the high-priority and regular-priority lists. The search spaces are left intact and can be posted again afterwards. Individual search spaces automatically stop their own query when they exit the scene tree or are freed, so this method is mainly useful when you want to cancel all active queries at once (for example, when resetting or changing scenes).

method.name: get_num_active_high_priority_queries
method.description: Returns the number of high priority queries currently posted to the system.

method.name: get_num_active_regular_priority_queries
method.description: Returns the number of regular priority queries currently posted to the system.

method.name: get_post_queries_time_elapsed_usec
method.description: Returns the microseconds spent in [method post_query] calls during the previous frame. This is the [code]NNNodeQuerySystem/Post queries time usec[/code] monitor.

method.name: get_run_queries_time_elapsed_usec
method.description: Returns the microseconds the last [method run_queries] call took. This is the [code]NNNodeQuerySystem/Run queries time usec[/code] monitor.

method.name: initialize_performance_counters
method.description: Registers the custom performance monitors ([code]NNNodeQuerySystem/Run queries time usec[/code] and [code]NNNodeQuerySystem/Post queries time usec[/code]) with [Performance] so they appear in the editor's Debugger Monitors tab. These monitors are not registered automatically on startup; call this method once (for example, in [method Node._ready]) to enable them. Subsequent calls have no effect.

method.name: post_query
method.description: Adds [param search_space] to the queue of queries executed by [method run_queries] and starts the query. When [param is_high_priority] is [code]true[/code], the search space is added to the high-priority queue; when [code]false[/code], it is added to the regular-priority queue. Returns [code]1[/code] if the query was posted, or [code]-1[/code] if [param search_space] is [code]null[/code] or is already posted.

method.name: run_queries
method.description: Runs the posted queries. Call this once per frame in your main scene.

method.name: stop_query
method.description: This stops the search_space query by removing it from the list of queries to be executed when the method [method run_queries] is called. The search space's [member NNNQSSearchSpaces.is_query_still_running] is set to [code]false[/code]. Returns [code]true[/code] when this call removed the query, and [code]false[/code] when the search space was not posted (including repeated calls for a query that was already stopped or completed).

members.member: Per-slice time budget in microseconds that [method run_queries] grants to each high-priority query per round-robin turn until the high-priority frame budget runs out. Must be at least [code]1[/code]; smaller values report an error and leave the value unchanged.

Per-slice time budget in microseconds that [method run_queries] grants to each regular-priority query per round-robin turn until the remaining frame budget runs out. Must be at least [code]1[/code]; smaller values report an error and leave the value unchanged.
Total time budget in microseconds allowed per [method run_queries] call. When the budget runs out, unfinished queries resume from where they left off on the next [method run_queries] call.

Fraction in the [code]0..1[/code] range of [member run_queries_time_budget_per_frame_usec] reserved for high-priority queries. Any remaining time in the frame budget is used for regular-priority queries; if high-priority queries consume the entire frame budget, regular-priority queries wait until a later frame.
